turns.question: How many euros more did a social lead cost us than a search lead in September 2026?
turns.answer: A social lead cost EUR 52.50 against EUR 42.07 for a search lead, so social cost EUR 10.43 more per lead, for cost per lead (EUR) over 1 to 30 September 2026 (total ad spend over total leads per channel).
